title: Mercury pill button
description: Soft, fully round pill buttons: a periwinkle primary, a quiet lavender-tinted secondary, a frosted glass pill for photo backdrops, and an underlined text link. Optional outward arrow for external links.
notes: glass is meant for busy backdrops (hero art, photos)
name: mercury-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description:
primary: periwinkle fill · secondary: a quiet tinted pill · glass: frosted, see-through
pill for photo or art backdrops · link: underlined text, no pill

props.name: external
props.description: a small outward arrow after the label, for links that leave the page

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link (e.g. "submit" inside a form)
